ten_architectural_learnings.name: reverse-gain-gnn-primitive
ten_architectural_learnings.description: The more effort an adversary spent producing deception signal X, the more X is anti-evidence for X. Formalized: signal.intent ∈ {mask, leak}; effective_bias = -bias if intent=mask else +bias

ten_architectural_learnings.name: legal-instrument-perjury-weight-1.0
ten_architectural_learnings.description: Sworn-under-perjury declarations (W-8BEN, W-9, 1099, affidavit, deposition) are the highest-weight LEAK signal. Single datapoint dominates when other signals are ambiguous.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: surname-distribution-prior
ten_architectural_learnings.description: Surname alone spreads probability across jurisdictions. Lee → CN/KR/JP/TW/HK. Resolved when paired with explicit country declaration.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: vpn-exit-adjacency-ring
ten_architectural_learnings.description: VPN exit choice reveals LATENCY-RING (HK exit = JP/KR/TW/CN/HK ring). Does NOT pin country; needs additional signal.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: voip-carrier-strip
ten_architectural_learnings.description: Area codes on VoIP/CLEC carriers (Bandwidth.com, Level 3, Twilio, TextFree) are geographically meaningless. Strip from geo inference.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: timezone-activity-window-leak
ten_architectural_learnings.description: Session-timestamp clustering across days reveals UTC+N working window. Strong leak signal.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: population-imbalance-reset-trigger
ten_architectural_learnings.description: Rare-class ratio > 100:1 → iterative GNN requires periodic-reset-halve@N primitive or saturation collapses the reward loop.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: candidate-set-completeness-meta-rule
ten_architectural_learnings.description: GNN inference is bounded by the candidate set. When VPN-HK ring observed, candidate set MUST include {JP, KR, TW, CN, HK, SG, MY, PH, TH, VN, ID} — missing any causes false precision.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: identity-laundering-flag
ten_architectural_learnings.description: Multiple foreign W-8BENs under different names/countries in same payment chain = identity-laundering flag. Warrants L4 elevated evidence.

ten_architectural_learnings.name: ocr-sec-review-gate
ten_architectural_learnings.description: OCR'd text MUST pass prompt-injection review before Shannon L3+ consumes. Status ∈ {clean, suspicious, high}. High-risk cannot bypass L2 gate.
